responsibility: Implements high-level loop transformation utilities shared by multiple tree loop passes. It provides routines to create induction variables, rewrite escaping defs into loop-closed SSA, split exits, choose increment positions, duplicate loop bodies, canonicalize loop PHIs around a single IV, and perform loop transform-and-unroll operations while preserving CFG, profile, and SSA correctness, serving as the common loop-manipulation substrate rather than a standalone optimization pass.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared loop-transformation routines, such as create_iv, loop-closed-SSA rewriting, unrolling helpers, and canonicalize_loop_ivs. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-manip.h, this file contains the transformation code itself rather than just the exported API declarations.
